title: Lemonade Change
statement: Lemonade costs 5. Customers pay with bills of 5, 10, or 20, in the given order. You start with no cash. Return true when you can give the correct change to every customer.
hints: A 5 needs no change and becomes a bill you can use later.
A 20 prefers a 10 plus a 5, because a 10 is less useful later than three 5s. If you have no 10, use three 5s.

approaches.name: Simulate every bill combination
approaches.explanation: Unnecessary. The greedy choice is forced.

editorial: Only 5s and 10s are useful change. Spend a 10 before three 5s on a 20, because a later 10-bill customer can only be served by a 5. If a required bill is missing, return false immediately.

examples.explanation: The 20 is paid with a 10 and a 5.
The last customer cannot be given change.
